summary: {audiologist} meets a patient who bought a hearing aid elsewhere and wants help using it.
realLife: GAO summarized a survey in which most audiologists reported broadly steady patient volume while some reported requests for help with retail devices.
inGame: needs: appointment reason and separately priced support.

turns.pulledBy: The practice offers a separate support appointment.
turns.what: A receptionist asks what help the patient needs.
turns.writesBack: The patient can ask what that visit will cost.

turns.pulledBy: The practice services only devices it supplies.
turns.what: The buyer calls the office that fit their previous device.
turns.writesBack: The patient takes the support question back to the seller.
